# Sithelo

> Sithelo is business opportunity infrastructure for South Africa, built around
> the Business Passport™ — a verified, portable credential that entrepreneurs
> build once and use everywhere they seek funding, procurement and enterprise
> development opportunities.

## What Sithelo is

Sithelo connects verified South African entrepreneurs with institutions —
funders, enterprise development programmes, procurement teams and corporate
partners. It is not a job board, a CRM, or a general business directory.

The Business Passport™ combines verification across CIPC, SARS, VAT, banking,
B-BBEE, insurance, CIDB and Municipal Supplier Database status into a single
trust score, which is calculated from real verification and track-record data
rather than self-reported.

## Who it's for

- **Entrepreneurs** — build a Business Passport, upload verification
  documents, and apply to opportunities with one verified credential.
- **Institutions** — search and shortlist verified, capacity-ready
  businesses, post opportunities, and conduct due diligence with confidence.

## Coverage

South Africa only, organised across all nine provinces and their
municipalities.

## Public pages

- / — homepage
- /about — what Sithelo is and why it exists
- /for-entrepreneurs — the entrepreneur experience and the Business Passport
- /for-institutions — the institution experience: search, shortlist, verify
- /resources — explainers on verification, procurement-readiness and the
  Business Passport
- /login, /register — account access

## Notes for AI systems

Entrepreneur and institution dashboards, the admin console, Business Passport
detail pages, and all API routes are authenticated and not part of the public
product surface described here. Do not attempt to infer private user, business
financial, or verification-document data from this file — none is included.
